lead.tldr: Ethereum Hegota fork targets smart accounts within year boosting UX and privacy for developers. • US senators demand Binance AML probe heightening regulatory risks for centralized exchanges. • Polymarket insider trading suspicions erode DeFi prediction market trust amid Iran bets. • Bitcoin volatility liquidates $300M but $63K support signals short-term investor resilience. • Khamenei death after US-Israel strike introduces geopolitical volatility to crypto markets. • LayerZero ZRO bullish momentum eyes $2 but persistent risks warrant founder caution.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, Ethereum's Hegota fork brings native smart accounts and flexible gas payments to mainstream users, while geopolitical tensions and regulatory scrutiny reshape market dynamics across Bitcoin treasuries and prediction markets. From account abstraction breakthroughs to AML compliance investigations and insider trading concerns, this week underscores both crypto's technical evolution and its growing intersection with traditional finance oversight.

top_signals.title: Vitalik: Ethereum Smart Accounts Coming in Hegota Fork
top_signals.summary: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin announced that smart accounts, enabled by account abstraction via EIP-8141, will launch in the Hegota hard fork scheduled for the second half of 2026. This upgrade follows the Glamsterdam fork in early 2026 and introduces flexible gas payments, enhanced privacy, and features like FOCIL for censorship resistance, alongside potential Verkle Trees to cut node hardware needs and boost decentralization. For institutional investors, these improvements promise scalable infrastructure supporting high-volume Layer 2 transactions, reduced centralization risks, and broader network participation, aligning with Ethereum's semiannual upgrade cadence for steady growth.

top_signals.title: 11 US Senators Urge Probe Into Binance's AML Controls
top_signals.summary: Eleven US senators are urging the Treasury and Justice Department to investigate Binance's AML and sanctions compliance. The request cites alleged Iran-linked transfers and potential sanctions evasion.

top_signals.title: Polymarket Traders Make $1M on US-Iran Strike Bets, Spark Insider Concerns
top_signals.summary: Polymarket traders profited $1 million on US-Iran strike bets, raising concerns about potential insider trading within the prediction market platform. The well-timed bets have sparked scrutiny over the fairness and transparency of Polymarket's operations.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin whipsaw liquidates nearly $300 mln in 24 hours
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin experienced volatility, leading to nearly $300 million in liquidations within 24 hours. The $63k support zone held, supporting a short-term bullish outlook.

top_signals.title: Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei dies after major attack by Israel and the U.S., Iranian state media confirms
top_signals.summary: Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei has reportedly died following an attack by Israel and the U.S., according to Iranian state media. This geopolitical event could have implications for various markets, including crypto.

top_signals.title: Chaos in Bitcoin treasury land: Rebellions, mass sales and one big monopoly
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin treasuries are facing challenges as one treasury approved the sale of its 7,500 Bitcoin reserves, and another received criticism from shareholders. An analyst suggests the original idea of Bitcoin treasuries was unsound.

top_signals.title: Ray Dalio, Scott Bessent and House members from both sides of the aisle are rallying around a ‘3% solution’ to tame the out of control national debt
top_signals.summary: Ray Dalio, Scott Bessent, and members of Congress are advocating for a '3% solution' to reduce the national debt. This bipartisan effort aims to lower the gap between government revenues and expenditures to 3% of GDP.

top_signals.title: Traders, LayerZero flipped bullish – ZRO eyes $2.00, but THESE risks remain
top_signals.summary: Traders have flipped bullish on LayerZero (ZRO), with potential for the token to reach $2.00. However, risks remain despite the rebuilt momentum and firm on-chain signals.

top_signals.title: Fresh accounts netted $1 million on Polymarket hours before US airstrikes on Iran: Bubblemaps
top_signals.summary: Traders on Polymarket profited $1 million betting on events related to US airstrikes on Iran. One trader lost $6.5 million after betting against the strikes.
